title: Recurring legal settlement adjustment is unsupported as non-recurring; management Adjusted EBITDA overstates price basis
finding: The FY2025 management bridge adds back a $2.1M 'One-time legal settlement' to EBITDA, but board minutes describe the FY2025 item as the third annual settlement in an ongoing series and the structured adjustment history shows the same category and amount in FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025. On the stated M1 method, EV impact is $-25.2M, calculated as the unsupported $2.1M add-back multiplied by the 12.0x entry multiple from deal settings.

evidence.quote: the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes

evidence.sql: SELECT category, fiscal_year, amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment ORDER BY category, fiscal_year

mitigation: Remove ADJ-003 from the price basis unless seller produces executed settlement documents showing the FY2025 item is outside the recurring run-rate.
what_would_raise_confidence: Executed settlement agreements, legal invoices, and FY2026 board/legal papers showing whether another settlement was expected or accrued.
ev_method_explained: M1 Earnings: EV impact equals negative unsupported adjustment amount times the 12.0x entry multiple from deal settings.

title: Northwind can withhold change-of-control consent and terminate; management summary says no restriction
finding: The executed Northwind MSA treats a supplier change of control as an assignment requiring prior written consent, and allows termination if the transaction completes without consent. The same contract also expires three months after the 31 March 2026 close with no automatic renewal. On the stated M2 method, EV impact is $-17.7M, calculated in SQL as ARR at risk of $10.55M times 40% contribution margin times 35% loss probability times the 12.0x entry multiple; escrow suggestion equals the full ARR at risk.

evidence.section: Section 14.2 Assignment and Change of Control
evidence.quote: Change of Control of Supplier shall constitute an assignment for the purposes of this Section 14.2.
Customer may terminate this Agreement on ninety (90) days' written notice
| CTR-00001 | Northwind Retail Group | 7,600,000 | 2026-06-30 | No | None noted | No | No | Long-standing relationship, renewal expected |

evidence.sql: SELECT arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0001' AND to_date(snapshot_month) = DATE '2025-12-01'

mitigation: Obtain Northwind written consent before signing or closing and begin renewal discussions immediately because the contract expires within 12 months of close.
what_would_raise_confidence: Signed consent correspondence from Northwind or confirmation no amendment supersedes Sections 14.2 and 14.3.
ev_method_explained: M2 Contract ARR at risk: EV impact equals negative ARR at risk times 40% contribution margin times 35% loss probability times the 12.0x entry multiple; probability selected because consent is needed on change of control and termination right exists if consent is not given, with expiry also within 12 months of close.
for_counsel: What consent process, if any, is required before signing or closing a sale transaction involving Harborline under Section 14.2 and 14.3?

title: Vantage MFN may require discount true-up after Pinnacle received a 34% discount
finding: The executed Vantage MSA states its 18% discount must remain no less favorable than discounts granted to any customer with comparable annual committed spend, and requires retrospective application of a better discount. Pinnacle's executed contract grants a 34% discount, and the structured contract data shows Pinnacle's ACV meets the 50% comparability threshold. On the stated M3 method, SQL calculates an annual credit of $913,445.33 and back credit of $763,364.04, producing EV impact of $-11.7M as negative ((annual credit x 12.0x) + back credit); whether Pinnacle qualifies as a comparable customer remains a counsel question.

evidence.quote: is and shall remain not less favourable than the effective discount granted by Supplier to any other customer
retrospectively from the date such discount was first granted to the other customer
Comparable annual committed spend means annual committed spend of not less than fifty per cent (50%)
Supplier grants a discount of thirty-four per cent (34%) against list pricing

evidence.sql: SELECT b.contract_id AS other_contract_id, b.customer_id AS other_customer_id, b.discount_pct AS other_discount_pct, b.acv_usd AS other_acv_usd, a.discount_pct AS vantage_discount_pct, a.acv_usd AS vantage_acv_usd, b.acv_usd >= 0.5 * a.acv_usd AS comparable FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract a JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract b ON a.contract_id <> b.contract_id WHERE a.contract_id = 'CTR-00002' AND b.discount_pct > a.discount_pct ORDER BY b.discount_pct DESC
SELECT arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0002' AND to_date(snapshot_month) = DATE '2025-12-01'
SELECT SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS invoiced_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0002' AND to_date(invoice_date) >= to_date('2025-03-14')

mitigation: Quantify and settle any Vantage credit exposure before close, and freeze further comparable pricing concessions until counsel confirms MFN scope.
what_would_raise_confidence: The full Vantage pricing schedule, any MFN exceptions, and billing or credit history showing whether Harborline already assessed or satisfied the clause after the 14 March 2025 Pinnacle approval.
ev_method_explained: M3 Most-favoured pricing: annual credit equals Vantage ARR times the discount delta adjusted by net price; back credit equals Vantage invoiced amount since 14 March 2025 times the same factor; EV impact equals negative ((annual credit x 12.0x) + back credit).
for_counsel: Does Pinnacle count as a 'customer of comparable annual committed spend' under Sections 8.4 and 8.5, and if so from what date would any retrospective credit run?

Board minutes state the customer has invoked the escalation provision and placed the FY2027 renewal under active review. On the stated M2 method, EV impact is $-6.7M, calculated in SQL as ARR at risk of $4.68M times 40% contribution margin times 30% loss probability times the 12.0x entry multiple; escrow suggestion equals the full ARR at risk.

evidence.quote: Customer may terminate for material breach on thirty (30) days' notice.
Customer's remedies under Section 12.2 shall be available.
has invoked the escalation provision of the MSA and has placed the FY2027 renewal "under active review"

evidence.sql: SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS sev1_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', to_date(opened_date)) AS month_start FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0002') m JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket t ON t.customer_id = 'CUST-0002' AND t.severity = 'S1' AND to_date(t.opened_date) >= m.month_start AND to_date(t.opened_date) < add_months(m.month_start, 3) GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY sev1_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0002' AND to_date(snapshot_month) = DATE '2025-12-01'

mitigation: Obtain a documented retention plan, verify uptime calculations, and engage Vantage before signing to assess whether escalation can be resolved before the non-renewal window opens.
spa_protection: escrow or holdback sized to the risk
what_would_raise_confidence: Monthly uptime calculations for Vantage and any customer escalation notices or cure communications.
ev_method_explained: M2 Contract ARR at risk: EV impact equals negative ARR at risk times 40% contribution margin times 30% loss probability times the 12.0x entry multiple; probability selected because renewal is under active review and escalation has been invoked.

title: Europe direct expansion is constrained by Atlas territorial exclusivity and current platform capability
finding: The executed Atlas agreement grants sole and exclusive distribution rights in the EU, UK, Switzerland and Norway and bars direct or indirect sales to customers in that territory during the term, while the CIM presents direct European expansion as a core growth vector. Management's IT overview also says the plan assumes a $6M ARR European direct business served from the existing single-region US deployment and that no EU data residency capability exists today. Under M6, EV impact is set to $0 because the issue does not change today's price-basis EBITDA on the evidence provided, but it directly constrains a stated growth plan.

evidence.quote: Supplier appoints Reseller as its sole and exclusive distributor of the Harborline Platform in the Territory.
Supplier shall not, whether directly or through any affiliate, agent, or other reseller, market
Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
No EU data residency capability exists today.

evidence.sql: SELECT arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0004' AND to_date(snapshot_month) = DATE '2025-12-01'
SELECT CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) AS ev_impact_usd

mitigation: Obtain an Atlas waiver or amendment before underwriting direct Europe expansion, and produce a dated capability roadmap for EU hosting and compliance.
what_would_raise_confidence: Any amendment, waiver, or side letter on Section 4.3 and successor obligations, plus a documented product and infrastructure roadmap for EU deployment.
ev_method_explained: M6 Strategy: EV impact is set to 0 because the evidence shows a constraint on a forward growth plan rather than a reduction to current price-basis EBITDA.
for_counsel: Does the contract's bar on direct or indirect selling to customers whose principal place of business is in the Territory prohibit the contemplated direct Europe plan as structured?

title: Recurring revenue classification is valuation-method dependent and 10.94% of FY2025 revenue fails the restated test
finding: Management-tagged recurring revenue was $42.02M, but the stricter restated test supported only $37.34M, leaving $4.68M of FY2025 revenue tagged recurring that failed the restated test. Because deal settings did not provide recurring and non-recurring revenue multiples, EV impact is null and valuation-method dependent. Severity is Medium because the affected revenue equals 10.94% of FY2025 revenue under SQL evidence.

evidence.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id=p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025) SELECT ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(tagged_revenue,2) AS tagged_revenue, ROUND(100*tagged_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS tagged_pct, ROUND(restated_revenue,2) AS restated_revenue, ROUND(100*restated_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS restated_pct, ROUND(tagged_failing_restated_amount,2) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM x

mitigation: Require a line-by-line recurring revenue policy and reclassify the 421 lines before final valuation work.
what_would_raise_confidence: Contract-level billing support or product master rules proving whether the 421 tagged lines without restated support should still count as recurring.
ev_method_explained: M4 Revenue quality: EV impact is null because deal settings did not provide recurring and non-recurring revenue multiples; severity is based on the SQL-computed 10.94% share of revenue affected.

title: Weighted collection days are above the claimed 45-day level, but full DSO normalisation is not fully supported
finding: SQL-calculated weighted collection days for FY2025 Q4 were 53.8 days versus the claimed 45 days, and board minutes state receivables from the three largest customers extended materially during the year. Using the stated M5 formula with FY2025 revenue of $42.73M, SQL calculates a $-1.03M working-capital adjustment. This should be treated as directional because the data room supports weighted collection days more directly than a full AR-ledger DSO measure.

evidence.quote: receivables from the three largest customers had extended materially during the year

evidence.sql: SELECT concat(year(to_date(i.invoice_date)), '-Q', quarter(to_date(i.invoice_date))) AS q, ROUND(AVG(c.days_outstanding), 1) AS avg_days, ROUND(SUM(c.days_outstanding * i.invoice_amount_usd) / SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd), 1) AS weighted_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON c.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

mitigation: Rebuild a true AR-ledger DSO and set the normalized working-capital peg with customer-level overdue balances before signing.
what_would_raise_confidence: A true AR balance ledger or due-date based DSO schedule, because the data room supports weighted collection days more directly than full traditional DSO.
ev_method_explained: M5 Working capital: EV impact equals negative excess days times claim-year revenue divided by 365, using 53.8 weighted days versus the claimed 45.0 days and FY2025 revenue of $42.73M. The result is directional because a full AR-ledger DSO was not supported in the data room.
